metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji lower in December 2020 than December 2019?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare mean NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) for Mount Fuji between December 2020 and December 2019. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery which has NDSI capability 2. Define Mount Fuji location (point or polygon around the mountain) 3. Filter for December 2019 and December 2020 4. Calculate NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) 5. Mask clouds using QA60 band 6. Check for empty collections and valid pixels 7. Compare mean NDSI values Potential issues: - Heavy cloud cover in December (common in Japan) - Snow cover variability - Need to handle collection size checks and fallbacks I'll use Sentinel-2 MSI L2A which has surface reflectance and good cloud masking. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.7274, 35.3606]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Mount Fuji // Define date ranges for December 2019 and 2020 const dec2019 = ['2019-12-01', '2019-12-31']; const dec2020 = ['2020-12-01', '2020-12-31']; // Function to calculate NDSI function calculateNDSI(img) { const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); // Green(B3) and SWIR(B11) return img.addBands(ndsi); } // Function to mask clouds function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(mountFuji) .filterDate(dec2019[0], dec2019[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(calculateNDSI); let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(mountFuji) .filterDate(dec2020[0], dec2020[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(calculateNDSI); // Check collection sizes const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const composite2019 = col2019.median(); const composite2020 = col2020.median(); // 3. Processing - Get pixel counts and mean NDSI const stats2019 = composite2019.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: mountFuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = composite2020.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: mountFuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2019 = stats2019.get('NDSI_mean').getInfo(); const count2019 = stats2019.get('NDSI_count').getInfo(); const mean2020 = stats2020.get('NDSI_mean').getInfo(); const count2020 = stats2020.get('NDSI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2019: Mean NDSI=${mean2019?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2019}`); console.log(`2020: Mean NDSI=${mean2020?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2020}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020) || mean2019 < -1 || mean2019 > 1 || mean2020 < -1 || mean2020 > 1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2020 < mean2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
